title: Parity suite never runs under any a11y mode or scale — AC 'full input parity holds under every a11y mode' has no test leg
evidence: parity.odin:188-194: '// 7.3: the settings chip text reads the active palette mode — load the / // embedded canon palette so the parity view is complete ... pal := rnd.palette_load() / view.palette = &pal' — the palette is loaded for chip TEXT only; every scenario drives the view at mode Off / x1.00; grep 'ui_scale|a11y' in parity.odin finds no scenario setting a mode or scale step.
detail: Carried since round 1. The r7 delta (4 files) adds no per-mode parity leg; the AC-1 claim remains untested.
recommended_fix: Drive the settings-panel and modal-blocks-world scenarios once per a11y mode (deutan/protan/tritan/reduced/x1.25/x1.50) asserting identical command streams.

title: x1.25 step and the 1152x648 min-window no-overlap AC exercised by no golden, parity, or presence leg
evidence: a11y_scale.dem line 1: 'a11y scale 150' — only x1.00 (implicit) and x1.50 paths exist; grep for 1152/648 in demos/ and harness/*.odin returns no window-size leg; harness renders at a fixed 1280x720.
detail: Carried since round 2 (W15). The mid step and the min-window clamp AC remain unexercised at every level.
recommended_fix: Add an a11y scale 125 demo/golden plus a 1152x648 layout leg (or unit-leg the clamps), or un-pin the AC claim.

title: a11y_reduced and a11y_scale goldens have no presence/content oracle — they rely on the T2 pixel hash alone
evidence: grep -n 'a11y_reduced|a11y_scale' harness/palcheck.odin -> no matches; palcheck's presence scans cover palette-mode goldens only.
detail: Carried since round 1. The reduced-motion readability contract (banner+glyph+outline render) and scaled-chrome presence are pinned only by an opaque hash, not by an oracle.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck with reduced/scale presence scans (banner card pixels, steady ring, scaled health-card geometry).

title: Settings_Navigate row-wrap boundaries (Up from row 0, Down from row 3) untested at exec level
evidence: exec.odin:62-64: 'r := inp.panel_row + v.delta / if r < 0 { r += n } / if r >= n { r -= n }' — grep across app/*_test.odin and harness/parity.odin finds no wrap assertion; only the pure scale/palette cycle wraps are pinned.
detail: Wrap arithmetic is a one-line-off class; the r7 delta adds no nav-wrap leg.
recommended_fix: Add an exec-level nav leg asserting Up-from-row-0 wraps to row 3 and Down-from-row-3 wraps to row 0.

title: New a11y demo-directive parser has no unit coverage (no parse_demo test exists)
evidence: demo.odin:553: 'return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y scale (want: a11y scale <100|125|150>): %s", line)' — ls harness/*test* shows only a11y_oracle_test.odin; no parser test exercises the a11y verb (including its silent tolerance of trailing tokens).
detail: Carried since round 6. The directive parser (incl. the ignores-trailing-tokens leniency) is exercised only incidentally by the 5 demos.
recommended_fix: Add a parse_demo unit test covering the a11y verb's valid and malformed forms.

title: New audio adjust exec leg pins only the mute toggle — no persistence assert, consistent with the mute byte never being persisted (carried W7)
evidence: settings_adjust_audio_effect: 'effect_settings_adjust(&app, &app.input, rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO, 0) / testing.expect(t, au.is_muted(&app.audio), "audio row toggles the mute (wired)")' — no settings_load_at assert (unlike the palette/motion/scale legs); A11y_Settings carries no mute byte, so SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO routes through settings_save_app writing a file that cannot record it.
detail: Extends the carried W7 persistence gap; the test honestly covers what ships, but mute resets on relaunch and no test would catch a future regression either way.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) and add the missing saved-audio assert, mirroring the other three legs.
